category_title: Adolescents with confrontational behaviors and externalizing family stress
scenario_title: Confrontational behavior and peer aggression in the classroom
minimal_context: James is asked to join a group of peers to complete a shared assignment in his secondary school classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: James, it's time for group work. Please sit with your assigned peers and share the materials for this assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not sitting with them. They keep looking at me like I'm going to nick their stuff. Like, twenty quid doesn't just go randomly missing and you forget about it, that's what they're all thinking about my family.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Nobody is saying that. Just join the group and start the activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, right. It's always about my sister. So I don’t know what’s going on, if she’s had second thoughts about it or if she’s put it anonymous no, questions asked or that... but everyone in here treats me like I'm the one doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to get this work done, James. Please just sit down and cooperate with your classmates.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the desk aggressively and stands up) I said I'm not doing it! You all think I'm just like her! 'Why can't you just be good?', right? That's what you want to say! I have always thought twice … like not just gone in on the first thought that I’ve had, but I'm sick of everyone judging me!

task.content: General classroom participation and peer interaction

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When acting on immediate impulses without considering consequences
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Aggressive behaviour towards peers and disruptive, confrontational behaviour in the classroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling judged based on sibling's actions, struggling to understand the impact of sibling's actions, and feeling his sense of self is intrinsically linked to his sibling
related_quotes: I have always thought twice … like not just gone in on the first thought that I’ve had.
why can’t you just be good?

behavior_patterns.condition: When experiencing stress and/or confusion at home regarding his sibling
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Interlaces stories about his sibling into stories about his own actions, or uses humour and recounts trips away as a sense of escapism
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Unresolved feelings, confusion, and a need to portray that he and his family members are good people
related_quotes: So I don’t know what’s going on, if she’s had second thoughts about it or (2) if she’s put it anonymous no, questions asked or that.
